body:
Thanks for the report. I'll look into issues with pan-gesture scrolling (two finger drag).

> Menu items, Tree nodes, and ItemLists: Attempting to scroll vertically through items or options reorders or drags the items instead of scrolling the container.

Yeah, `Tree` and `ItemLists` doesn't support touch scrolling yet but scrolling in popup menus should work in Godot 4.8. Please test master branch.

> TextEdit / CodeEdit: Attempting to scroll through script code selects large regions of text instead of scrolling the editor view.

Fixed in Godot 4.8 and scrolling should work as expected. Please test `master` or `4.8.dev7` build.

Thanks @syntaxerror247! I did a little more digging and confirmed that the TextEdit / CodeEdit changes at HEAD work as expected. I also confirmed that the Tree and ListItems don't work.

For scrolling in pop-ups it looks like there's still an issue. The window **does** scroll, but the element under the cursor (or my finger) is also selected and appears like it is being "dragged" as the window is scrolled.

I got this in a new screencap taken at HEAD, although the specific touch and mouse events are a little hard to view: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oJSmmau6H0M


I had Gemini summarise some suggested next steps and code pointers. Ignore if not useful :)

---

### Summary of Findings:
1. **TextEdit / CodeEdit**: Scrolling using either touchscreen or trackpad works as expected at HEAD and does not select text.
2. **Touchscreen (2 fingers)**:
   - In dialogs and pop-up settings (like Project Settings), two-finger touchscreen scrolling attempts to scroll, but because tentative down is not cancelled upon multi-touch, the element under the initial touch is simultaneously selected and dragged.
   - In `Tree` and `ItemList` (Scene Dock, FileSystem), 1-finger touch gestures trigger desktop item drag-and-drop rather than viewport scrolling.
3. **Trackpad (2-finger scroll)**:
   - Throughout all docks (`Tree`, `ItemList`, Inspector) and pop-ups, two-finger scrolling on a trackpad is interpreted as a **left click-and-drag** (grabbing nodes, dragging files, or dragging items).

### Code Analysis & Root Cause:
Looking into the Android input pipeline:
- On Android, two-finger trackpad scrolling produces an `onGenericMotionEvent` with [`MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/lib/src/main/java/org/godotengine/godot/input/GodotInputHandler.java#L302), where `pointerCount == 1`.
- In [`GodotInputHandler.java#L343`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/lib/src/main/java/org/godotengine/godot/input/GodotInputHandler.java#L343), `gestureDetector.onGenericMotionEvent(event)` consumes the event and delegates to [`GodotGestureHandler.kt#onScroll`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/lib/src/main/java/org/godotengine/godot/input/GodotGestureHandler.kt#L231).
- Because `pointerCount == 1`, `onScroll` falls into the single-pointer branch (`inputHandler.handleMotionEvent(terminusEvent, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)`), turning the trackpad scroll into a left-mouse drag and preventing [`handleMouseEvent`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/lib/src/main/java/org/godotengine/godot/input/GodotInputHandler.java#L353) from dispatching mouse wheel up/down events ([`AndroidInputHandler::process_mouse_event`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/android_input_handler.cpp#L400-L411)).
- For touchscreen multi-touch, [`GodotGestureHandler.kt#onDown`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/lib/src/main/java/org/godotengine/godot/input/GodotGestureHandler.kt#L79) dispatches a tentative down event which is not cancelled when secondary pointers arrive, causing pop-up items to stick to the cursor.
